conflicting_project_information.label: Conflicting project information
conflicting_project_information.higher: Conflicting project information contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
conflicting_project_information.lower: No conflicting project information contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.

critical_field_missing.label: Missing critical project information
critical_field_missing.higher: Missing critical project information contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
critical_field_missing.lower: Availability of critical project information contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.

multiple_candidate_records.label: Multiple candidate project records
multiple_candidate_records.higher: Multiple candidate project records contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
multiple_candidate_records.lower: A more clearly identified project record contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.

prior_escalation_rate.label: Historical escalation pattern
prior_escalation_rate.higher: The workflow's historical escalation pattern, relative to the model's training reference, contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
prior_escalation_rate.lower: The workflow's historical escalation pattern, relative to the model's training reference, contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.

payment_chain_completeness_score.label: Payment-chain information completeness
payment_chain_completeness_score.higher: Lower payment-chain information completeness relative to the model's training reference contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
payment_chain_completeness_score.lower: Higher payment-chain information completeness relative to the model's training reference contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.

deadline_days_remaining.label: Deadline proximity
deadline_days_remaining.higher: Greater deadline urgency relative to the model's training reference contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
deadline_days_remaining.lower: More time remaining relative to the model's training reference contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.

research_confidence_score.label: Project research confidence
research_confidence_score.higher: Lower project research confidence relative to the model's training reference contributed to a higher predicted operational risk score.
research_confidence_score.lower: Higher project research confidence relative to the model's training reference contributed to a lower predicted operational risk score.
